# Security

Please report duplication exploits, permission bypasses, exposed player data, and reproducible attacks that crash or damage a server through [GitHub's private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/RokeyDoess/JustJobs/security/advisories/new). Don't post working exploits in public issues.

Include the JustJobs and Paper versions, relevant settings, steps to reproduce, and the likely impact. Remove passwords, tokens, private addresses, and unrelated player data. Keep testing on a server you own or have permission to test.

Security fixes target the latest stable release. Older releases may need an update to receive a fix.

Ordinary bugs and reward balance suggestions belong in [Issues](https://github.com/RokeyDoess/JustJobs/issues/new/choose). Questions belong in [Discussions](https://github.com/RokeyDoess/JustJobs/discussions/categories/q-a).
